Junior Data Analyst — Kopi Analytics Pte. Ltd. (fictional)
Singapore — On-site (Tanjong Pagar)

Kopi Analytics helps F&B chains understand their sales through dashboards and reporting.

Job description
- Prepare weekly sales reports and dashboards in Power BI
- Clean and analyse data with Excel and SQL
- Support account managers with ad-hoc analyses for clients

Requirements
- Diploma or degree in Business Analytics, Statistics or related field
- Proficiency in Excel; basic SQL
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau is a plus
- Fresh graduates are welcome

Salary: SGD 3,800 – 4,500 per month
Contact: hr@kopianalytics.example
